canonical_view_rule: Primary inference includes each canonical patient-session-task once; release-specific unit/LFP views are linked sensitivity analyses and never independent cohorts.
registry_note: The registry holds 16 entries, including 'wolff_eeg_impulse', 'kai_miller_nback' and 'pfc3', so that every staged dataset is visible to any rule reading dataset identity from this file. 'label_convention' is the per-dataset key the region-vocabulary parser dispatch reads -- declared here, never sniffed at runtime.

dandi_000469.view_relationship: independent, confirmed by an all-pairs trial-content fingerprint audit; zero cross-release overlap found

dandi_001187.view_relationship: linked release view with dandi_000673 for 31 verified shared patients / 37 shared recording sessions (identified by matching native identifier, trial timestamps, accuracy and picture identifiers)

dandi_000673.view_relationship: linked release view with dandi_001187 for 31 verified shared patients / 37 shared recording sessions (identified by matching native identifier, trial timestamps, accuracy and picture identifiers)

dandi_000574.view_relationship: independent, confirmed by an all-pairs trial-content fingerprint audit; zero cross-release overlap found; multimodal single-unit+scalp-EEG+iEEG view (Sci Data 2020, doi:10.1038/s41597-020-0364-3) -- the same corpus at each grain, not a separate dataset

dandi_000004.view_relationship: independent recognition-memory corpus; eligibility for a task-generalization analysis is determined separately from metadata feasibility

panichello_2024.label_convention_note: Sessions resolve to three monkey clusters by session-count/date grouping, not per-channel anatomy: 2021 (10 sessions, monkey A, area 8); 2022 (8 sessions, monkey H, area 8 and 9/46, undetermined which); 2024 (7 sessions, monkey J, area 9/46). Mapping is inferred from deposited session metadata, not depositor-confirmed; see the staging audit for evidence and caveat.

watters_2026.modality_note: Was recorded as single_unit only, which undercounted what is staged: the shared per-trial spike cache carries 5228 multi-unit cluster files against 2857 well-isolated single-unit files across probes and sessions (quality-tier comparison), and both tiers are analysed.

ds004752.view_relationship: shares 9 of 15 patients (sub-01..sub-09) with the staged dandi_000574 release, confirmed by exact age/sex/pathology triple match against DANDI 000574 NWB subject metadata; sub-10..sub-15 are ds004752-only patients not in dandi_000574. Same site (Zurich), same verbal Sternberg task. Treated as a linked cross-modality view of the shared 9 patients, not an independent cohort, for any pooled patient count.
constructs: iEEG depth, LCMV-beamformed cortical virtual sensors, scalp EEG

pfc4.view_relationship: independent macaque prefrontal-cortex single-unit release (CRCNS pfc-4); confirmed from the released .mat files to contain exactly 2 animals (rr014, rr015), so it cannot compute an estimand requiring 4 or more independent units and must never be pooled with another corpus to reach that floor

kai_miller_nback.view_relationship: independent human ECoG n-back release (memory_nback library)

ds005034.view_relationship: independent healthy-participant human scalp-EEG theta-tACS working-memory release; 25 participants, each with both a sham and a verum memory-task recording on disk (50 memory recordings, every file complete and full-size), plus a separate resting-state recording per participant per session (50 resting recordings, not used by any analysis). An earlier entry here reported 18 participants with a recording and 7 with sidecar metadata only; that was counted while the download was still in flight and is superseded by a direct file count. No trial-level behavioural outcome ships in this local BIDS release (see behaviour_available below); accuracy exists only on a separate repository not present in this project's data root.
ds005034.retention_interval_note: single per-trial onset marker (task/load code) followed 6.5 s later by the next marker, no intervening events; the delay window used here is 0.5-6.5 s post onset, following the pre-existing scripts/run_ds005034_tacs_aftereffect.py convention

ds006848.view_relationship: independent healthy-participant human scalp-EEG verbal working-memory (digit span) release; 30 of 30 registered participants have both an EEG recording and trial-level behaviour on disk
ds006848.retention_interval_note: fixed 6.000 s stimulus-free retention interval, verified from the retention-onset to retrieval-onset event gap on every trial (Retention_* to Digits_Retrieval), no intervening events
